# omada_acls (Data Source)

Lists gateway, switch and EAP ACLs for discovery and import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_acls" "all" {}

output "acls" {
  value = data.omada_acls.all.acls
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
